task_grounding:
Open OBS Studio and create a scene with multiple source types.

1. Delete any existing default scenes so you start fresh.
2. Create a scene named exactly 'Presentation'.
3. With 'Presentation' selected, add the following three sources:
   a. A 'Display Capture' (or 'Screen Capture') source named exactly 'Screen'.
   b. An 'Image' source named exactly 'Logo'. Point it to the file /home/user/Pictures/logo.png.
   c. A 'Text (FreeType 2)' source (or 'Text' source) named exactly 'Title'. Set the text content to anything you like.
4. Make sure all three sources are visible in the scene.
5. The scene collection should contain exactly 1 scene ('Presentation') with all 3 sources.
6. Close OBS or let it auto-save.

Remove any other scenes besides 'Presentation'.

cli_feasibility.translation: Use 'source list' to find source, then 'source set --visible true/false'
cli_feasibility.reason: CLI can set source visibility using 'source set --visible true/false' command
